body:
Adds `research/milestone-schedules`: a stage-game model of milestone payments between an anonymous worker and requester with no external enforcement.

- A milestone is self-enforcing under some pre-payment split iff its cost is at most the pooled continuation value. Pay-after needs P/W_r equal milestones, pay-before needs C/W_w, and the best split needs C/(W_r+W_w).
- Front-loading gives a geometric schedule with a minimum of ceil(ln(1+(V-C)/W)/ln(V/C)) milestones (17 vs 100 in the example).
- Cheap re-entry caps W and costs ln(1/e) milestones.

Includes 8 tests, experiments, a whitepaper, the README bullet and the site entry. `python site/build.py` prints ok.
